note: Syria (arriving at Aleppo or Damascus airports): nationals of Algeria, Jordan, Lebanon, Mauritania, Morocco, Sudan, Tunisia, Türkiye and Yemen need no visa; the Gulf states, the EU, EFTA, the UK and the US get a visa on arrival (30 days, the Gulf's unstated), the former Soviet states listed and Malaysia for 15 days (Russians with an approval to board 48 hours ahead). Iranians need a visa in advance; Israelis are refused (taken as a visa). Land crossings and the e-visa platform, not yet operating, aren't modelled; every other nationality is taken to need a visa. Read from Wikipedia's copy.
